summary_en: Kadoya Sesame Mills announced that ITG-G Holdings increased the takeover bid price from 2,514 yen to 2,655 yen per share on November 6, 2026, representing an 11.37% premium to the closing price on September 11, 2026. The board maintained its recommendation for shareholders to accept the offer, with potential prices reaching up to 2,944 yen depending on agreements with major shareholders on self-share acquisitions.
title_en: Notice of Partial Changes to "Notice of Expression of Support and Recommendation to Apply for Public Tender Offer for the Company's Shares by ITG-G Holdings Corporation"
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Kadoya Sesame Mills announced that ITG-G Holdings Corporation increased its takeover bid price from the previously announced 2,514 yen per share to 2,655 yen per share. This revised price represents an 11.37% premium to the closing price on September 11, 2026 (2,384 yen), 35.11% premium to the one-month average (1,965 yen), 44.22% premium to the three-month average (1,841 yen), and 54.99% premium to the six-month average (1,713 yen). The company received the price increase proposal from Kazuhiko Ozawa (representing shareholder Ozawa Bussan and Ozawa Shoji) and Integral Corporation, which was contingent on Ozawa Bussan's participation in a self-share acquisition.

Under tiered scenarios based on agreements with major institutional shareholders to participate in self-share acquisitions rather than the tender offer, the bidder indicated potential prices of up to 2,944 yen (if all shares held by corporate shareholders are acquired), 2,806 yen (if all Mitsubishi Corporation shares are acquired), or 2,777 yen (if all Mitsui & Company shares are acquired). The company's board of directors maintained its recommendation for shareholders to accept the offer, with no change to the special committee's recommendation.
